displayName: Nightpace — Claude Code Usage Limits, Quota & API Cost
description: Claude Code usage limits forecast: when your 5-hour and weekly quota run out at your pace and with how many parallel sessions, the quota over time, and what it would cost at API prices by model, effort and token type. Local, no telemetry.
config.quota.enabled: Record your plan's 5-hour and weekly quota. Nightpace asks Claude Code for it every 5 minutes while you work and hourly otherwise; Claude Code gets the numbers from Anthropic, as it does for its own usage view. No prompt is sent and no quota is used.
